gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the data policy for my project to ensure compliance with data protection regulations.
gold.ideal: The response should return the current data policy details, including the policy ID, name, description, and any applicable regulations.

gold.user: As a compliance officer, I need to access all data policies associated with different projects to evaluate their adherence to legal standards.
gold.ideal: The response should provide a list of all data policies linked to projects, including each policy's ID, name, and description.
